A lens is attached to the body with its front cap on, so no lens markings, model number, or focal length ring are visible.
No top-plate or rear LCD shot is shown, so the specific camera model designation (e.g., 'D810') is not legible anywhere in the image.
Background shows a wall socket/switch, suggesting an indoor, informal photo setup typical of a quick listing shot.
Watermark 'STARSHOOT IMAGE' overlays the photo, which is just a seller/photographer watermark, not camera data.

Lens front cap is on in photo 0, hiding any focal length ring, brand markings, or model text on the lens barrel.

risks.proof: Clear photo of the top plate or rear LCD showing the model name (e.g., 'D810') stamped or displayed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lowest-value Nikon DSLR body consistent with the visible design, not as a D810

risks.proof: Photo with the front and rear caps off showing lens barrel text, mount, and glass clarity.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded/generic lens in unknown condition

risks.risk: Shutter count unknown, critical for a used pro-body DSLR's value.
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or EXIF data of a test shot.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high shutter count / heavily used

risks.risk: Functional status (sensor, autofocus, shutter, screen) not demonstrated.

risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the top plate or LCD screen showing the model name/number.
Photo of the lens with caps off, showing focal length ring and brand markings.
Photo or screenshot of shutter count from the camera's menu.
Short video of the camera powering on and firing the shutter.
Photo of all accessories included in the sale.
response.reason: The listed model (D810) materially sets the price but is not legible in the single photo provided, and the lens is capped so its identity cannot be checked either; a model-confirming shot is needed before even a worst-case price can be set.
